name: Latent View Analytics Ltd
title: Latent View Analytics Ltd - 543398 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Tech vertical shrinkage of ~$6.5-7M in largest account is the core drag; management guides FY27 organic growth 12-13% high-visibility, 18-20% target, with AI and Databricks as offsets, but no supply-side capacity signal.

utilisation.quote: utilization for this particular quarter going up from the 85% to almost 89% levels

triggers.label: Top tech account shrinkage ~$7M
triggers.quote: the total value of shrinkage was closer to about $6.5 million to $7 million

triggers.label: FY27 high-visibility growth 12-13%
triggers.quote: we have a reasonable level of confidence in terms of high visibility pipeline and order book to deliver about 12% to 13% of growth

triggers.label: Gross margin AI projects 55-58%
triggers.quote: we are seeing gross margins in the range of 55% to 58%

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA guided 21-22% at INR92
triggers.quote: what we planned for is an EBITDA between 21% to 22%

guidance.quote: we have a reasonable level of confidence in terms of high visibility pipeline and order book to deliver about 12% to 13% of growth
to deliver a growth rate, which is very similar to what we delivered this year
what we planned for is an EBITDA between 21% to 22%
technology vertical for this year, our sense is that it should be between 5% to 8% growth on a year-on-year basis
Consumer should, our sense is right now, should grow anywhere between 18% to 22%
they should grow at least at about 40% for the next year
the Databricks portfolio of work will continue to grow at about 60% plus
